recommendation.headline: Accept the dispute and issue a full refund because the order was shipped without tracking and cannot be proven as delivered.
recommendation.rationale: The buyer never received the item and opened an item-not-received dispute. Because the item was shipped via USPS First-Class letter without tracking, we have no proof of delivery or receipt to contest the claim. Fighting this dispute would be futile, so issuing a full refund immediately resolves the issue and saves seller time.

evidence.summary: Dispute PP-D-27802 was opened by Marcus Lee for $28.00 due to merchandise not received.

recommendation.response_to_paypal: We are issuing a full refund to the buyer as this low-value order was shipped via USPS First-Class letter without tracking.
